We’re Hiring | Help Build the Future of Encrypted Web3

At Fhenix, we’re not just writing code — we’re rewriting what’s possible in Web3 privacy. We’re a crew of builders, tinkerers, and crypto optimists working on the bleeding edge of fully homomorphic encryption (FHE). Why Work With Us?

At Fhenix, you're shaping the future of privacy on the internet.

We’re working on one of the most ambitious problems in blockchain: enabling encrypted computation on-chain. That means your work has real-world impact, pushing forward what’s possible in secure, decentralized systems — and helping developers and users reclaim control of their data.

But it’s not just about the mission. It’s about the people. When you join Fhenix, you join a team that cares deeply — about craft, about curiosity, and about each other. We invest in your growth, give you room to own your work, and celebrate the journey as much as the outcome.

You’ll do work that challenges you, with people who inspire you — and together, we’ll build something that truly matters.
